activeQuestion.prompt: A donor brings two labelled plants, one in glass. Without changing pots, when can they enter?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 捐贈者帶了兩盆貼好標籤的植物，其中一盆用玻璃盆。不換盆的話，何時可以入場？

options.whyZh: 玻璃盆不收，只有另外一盆符合規定，不到提早入場所需的兩盆。

options.text: Enter at eleven with the eligible plant.
options.zh: 十一點帶合格的那盆入場。
options.whyZh: 兩盆雖然都有標籤，但其中一盆用玻璃盆，不算合格；只有一盆就要等十一點入場。

options.text: Wait until noon and leave both plants at the volunteer table.
options.zh: 等到中午，把兩盆都留在志工桌。
options.whyZh: 中午的規定是處理沒被領走的植物，不會讓玻璃盆變成合格。

options.text: Enter early after showing that both plants have labels.
options.zh: 證明兩盆都有標籤後提早入場。
options.whyZh: 有標籤只是其中一項條件，仍不收玻璃盆。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 兩盆雖然都有標籤，但其中一盆用玻璃盆，不算合格；只有一盆就要等十一點入場。
activeQuestion.evidence: No glass pots; two eligible plants for early entry; other visitors enter at eleven.

vocabulary.note: 同時符合活動所列條件，而不是只貼了標籤。

originalQuestion.prompt: Why is the Riverside shop closed?

options.text: Its kitchen floor is being repaired.
options.whyZh: 語音訊息直接說 while the kitchen floor is being repaired，這是暫停營業的原因。

options.text: It has permanently moved to another city.
options.zh: 它已永久搬到另一個城市。
options.whyZh: 店家預計重新開門，temporary 表示不是永久搬遷。
這是正常電話錄音，並未宣布電話故障。

options.whyZh: 線上訂單由另一分店處理，並非因沒有訂單而關店。

group.title: A community plant swap
group.passage: Bring up to three labelled plants, but no glass pots. Two eligible plants earn early entry; everyone else enters at eleven. In rain, use the gym door, not the garden gate. Volunteers check labels at the open entrance. At twelve noon, volunteers send unclaimed plants to the library's gardening club. Plants with a return tag stay at the volunteer table. Give a volunteer your name before leaving to get that tag.
group.passageZh: 最多可帶三盆貼好標籤的植物，但不收玻璃盆。帶兩盆合格植物才可提早入場，其他人十一點入場。下雨時不要走花園大門，請改走體育館入口。志工會在開放的入口檢查標籤。中午十二點，志工會把沒被領走的植物送到圖書館的園藝社。有退還標籤的植物會留在志工桌。請在離開前向志工告知你的名字，才能取得這張標籤。
